purpose: Reusable Dify workflow and chatflow starter templates for CREATE SOMETHING Policy OS client delivery.

repo_owns: MCP server IDs and tool exposure policy
repo_boundary.not_live_inventory: Templates in this pack are not live Dify apps until imported into Dify Studio and codified in config/dify/inventory.json.

template_rules: Do not hardcode Dify API keys, MCP bearer tokens, provider tokens, customer data, or private examples.
Every write-capable tool must ask for explicit confirmation before use.
Every published clone must be added to config/dify/inventory.json with at least one smoke case.
Every published clone must have Langfuse eval gates for api_health, secret_refusal, latency_budget, and any enabled tool or write path.
Use client-specific MCP server IDs in Dify Studio, then update the cloned DSL and manifest after import.

templates.title: Policy OS Client Intake And MCP Audit
templates.recommended_dify_base_template: Patient Intake Chatbot plus Question Classifier
templates.client_value: Collects business context, systems, desired workflows, risk boundaries, and produces a scoped MCP audit brief.

templates.title: Client Knowledge And Runbook Assistant
templates.primary_audience: client teams using a delivered hub or workflow
templates.client_value: Answers what the agent can do, which tools are allowed, what requires approval, and how to troubleshoot common operations.

templates.title: Transcript To Notion Workflow
templates.primary_audience: operators who convert videos, calls, or meetings into durable notes
templates.client_value: Extracts transcript content, summarizes it, and optionally writes to Notion after confirmation.

templates.title: Support Triage And Reply Drafter
templates.recommended_dify_base_template: Question Classifier: Front Desk plus Customer Review Analysis
templates.primary_audience: support, community, and marketplace operations teams
templates.client_value: Classifies support intent, retrieves policy or KB context, drafts a reply, and escalates sensitive or ambiguous cases.
templates.placeholder_notes: Replace support-triage-mcp with the client MCP server card. For Webflow Marketplace use, bettermode-creator is the concrete source pattern.

templates.title: Governed Client Hub Router
templates.primary_audience: client users with a scoped MCP Hub lane
templates.client_value: Routes user intent to allowed client Hub services, describes available tools, and gates side effects behind explicit confirmation.
templates.placeholder_notes: Replace client_hub with the exact Dify MCP server ID for the client lane, such as morgan_hub or a new named-lane card.

templates.title: MCP Health Guard
templates.primary_audience: operators responsible for client MCP and Dify runtime readiness
templates.client_value: Checks MCP health, visible services, policy status, recent traces, and produces a client-safe readiness brief.
templates.placeholder_notes: Use only read Hub tools. Do not enable hub_refresh_connections, hub_update_state, hub_set_discovery, or brokered write calls in the base template.
